Coram : J.K. MAHESHWARI*, K.V. VISWANATHAN
Issue for Consideration Three appellants herein were appointed as Assistant Teachers at the Junior High School on 25.06.1999. From October, 2005, abruptly their salaries were stopped. Whether the State was justified in abruptly stopping their salary. Headnotes Service Law Stoppage of salary – The District Basic Education Officer case was that by order dated 26.12.1997, only two additional posts of Assistant Teacher were created by the Joint Director of Education – It was averred that manipulation was made by the management in collusion with the
